name: Phone
author: phonelink
description: Your Android phone in the bar: battery, signal and waiting messages

barWidget.description: Battery, cellular signal and how many conversations are waiting; click to open Messages

schema.label: Refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask the phone. Each check is one short D-Bus call.

schema.label: Signal
schema.description: Show cellular bars. Needs the phone-state permission in KDE Connect on Android; without it there is nothing to show.

schema.label: Waiting messages
schema.description: Show how many conversations are waiting for an answer.

schema.label: Low battery at
schema.description: Below this percentage the charge is drawn in the urgent colour.

schema.label: phonelink command
schema.description: Normally just "phonelink". Point this at a checkout to run one that is not installed.
